bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test -f "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 71
git -C "$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c" show cb3e13c2156f5f8b04645adb121057e88d1c2b4a:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 72
git -C "$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c" show cb3e13c2156f5f8b04645adb121057e88d1c2b4a:scripts/userbot_test_client.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 73
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin fix/userbot-public-smoke-client-action-20261113
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 5085a6b652ae9e362861b082de8cb09894bc7be5 || exit 74
tmp=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.userbot_test_client.XXXXXX")
git -C "$r" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp"
chmod 644 "$tmp"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast, pathlib
for x in pathlib.Path('scripts').glob('.userbot_test_client.*'):
 ast.parse(x.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
PY
mv "$tmp" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo USERBOT_PUBLIC_SMOKE_CLIENT_FIXED=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_UNCHANGED=PASS
